verdict.rationale: mise is fundamentally a CLI tool with an extensive official CLI reference documented (mise-probe-4), commands shown throughout docs (exec, use, run, activate, etc.), and it even ships a dedicated MCP server so AI assistants can inspect/run tasks (mise-docs-74), directly supporting AI-native/agentic workflows. Community evidence corroborates real-world CLI usage across polyglot toolchains. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability and no dedicated 'llms.txt'-driven agent workflow examples beyond the discovery probe.
